label: Congo and Rwanda's share of world tantalum mine production, 2025
method: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries 2026: DRC 1,300 t + Rwanda 400 t of 2,500 t world (contained tantalum, 2025). USGS estimates Rwanda's output from its exports, so the figure includes ore smuggled from Congo.

label: Congo and Rwanda's share of world tin mine production, 2025
method: USGS MCS 2026: DRC 27,000 t + Rwanda 4,600 t of 290,000 t world.

label: Congo and Rwanda's share of world gold mine production, 2024 (official)
method: USGS country yearbooks: DRC 27.9 t and Rwanda about 0.35 t of 3,280 t world. Undeclared artisanal gold would raise this to about 1.2%.

label: Rubaya's share of world tantalum
notes: Global Witness and IPIS give 15% without a method. Our cross-check from the UN's 120 t a month gives 9–19%.

label: Bisie mine (North Kivu) share of world tin, 2024
method: USGS: Bisie output against world mine production.
